episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her strategies for maintaining a successful YouTube channel that has generated over $150 million in real estate sales. She emphasizes the importance of consistency, having backup systems like a video bank and additional editors, and separating content planning from filming to ensure quality and sustainability. Her insights provide actionable tactics for real estate agents looking to leverage YouTube for lead generation and business growth.
